newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures finish lower on local, spec selling.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures finish lower on local, spec selling.

text.p: FCOJ futures closed lower after benchmark September delivery rallied to the 20-day moving average and failed to attract follow-through buying, trading sources said.
Local shortcovering carried the contract to a high of 75.40 cents a lb, where the locals became short and pressured prices.
The contract held support at 73.50 cents amid thin volume estimated at 2,000 lots.
Most-active September ended down 1.05 cents lower at 73.95 cents, traded 75.40 to 73.50 cents. The rest shed 1.20 to 0.55 cent.
